description: Safety and Security Agency Profiles is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. This dataset details raw totals and rates per 1 million unlinked passenger trips/vehicle revenue miles (UPT/VRM) for 5 different metrics: Major Passenger Assaults and Homicides, Major Worker Assaults and Homicides, Fatalities (safety), Fatalities (security), Fatalities (trespasser/suicide). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 18 columns, among them metric_ridership_6mo_avg_rate, month_year, value, metric, event_type, Agency. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
